name: Leader Poppy
lines: “Everything here grows back twice as fast. Including my temper, since the merch stalls arrived.”
“Let’s see if your team blooms under pressure.”
win: “You grew on me. Twice as fast. The Grass Badge is yours.”
lose: “Pull yourself up and plant again. Everything here grows back.”
hint: Leader Poppy’s Grass team is level 36–38. Fire and Flying moves wilt Grass Billies.

seat.title: Grass Badge · 5 of 8
seat.rewardText: 2 Bailouts, 3 Gold Coins and 2 Platinum Coins
seat.unlockText: The boardwalks of Rootwater Marsh, south-east of Twinpetal Town, are open.
